questions_and_answers.question: How is the passive voice formed in Hindi according to the grammar lesson?

answers.answer: By adding the suffix –ता to the verb
By inserting one of the आ/ए/ई endings plus जा into the verb phrase
By changing the verb to its infinitive form

questions_and_answers.question: In the past tense, how does **जाता** appear in the passive construction?
Which passive construction correctly translates ‘The doors will be opened’?
What is the correct passive form to say ‘The sari will be cleaned’?
Where does a clarifier (such as कर, ले, or दे) appear in a passive verb phrase?

answers.answer: At the very end of the sentence

questions_and_answers.question: Which postposition is used to mention the actor in a passive sentence?
What unusual passive form is produced by verbs containing **जाना**?
Which sentence translates ‘By whom was this book written?’?

answers.answer: यह किताब किस से लिखी गई?
यह किताब किस को लिखी गई?

questions_and_answers.question: What is the correct passive form for ‘The money will be given’?
Which of the following is NOT part of the passive formation as described?

answers.answer: Using the past form of the main verb

articles.text:
Forms of the passive voice in Hindi are formed by inserting one of the masculine (आ), plural (ए), or feminine (ई) endings plus **जा** into the verb phrase. The result looks like the past form of the main verb plus some form of **जाना**. In the past tenses, **जाता** appears as **गया**. The passive forms of **कहना** (to say) illustrate this:

• कहा जाता है — It is said.
• कहा जाएगा — It will be said.
• कहा गया — It was said.

When the direct object is mentioned in the direct case, the entire verb phrase agrees with it. For example:

• दरवाज़ा खोला जाएगा — The door will be opened.
• दरवाज़े खोले जाएँगे — The doors will be opened.
• खिड़की खोली जाएगी — The window will be opened.
• खिड़कियाँ खोली जाएँगी — The windows will be opened.

Contractions that normally occur in past forms of verbs like **करना**, **देना**, **पीना** also occur in the passive, for example:

• काम किया जाएगा — The job will be done.
• पैसे दिये जाएँगे — The money will be given.
• साड़ी साफ़ की जाएगी — The sari will be cleaned.

If a clarifier (such as कर, ले, or दे) is used, it comes immediately before the passive marker. All other verb elements follow. If the actor is mentioned, the postposition **से** is used, as in:

• यह किताब किस से लिखी गई? — By whom was this book written?

When the verb contains **जाना**, the passive produces an unusual form **जाया**, as in:

• सामान कूली से जाया गया — The luggage was taken away by the porter.
